environment.description: AWS Lambda (Node.js 18.x) behind API Gateway with Cognito authorizer. PostgreSQL 14 on RDS with RLS policies on tenant_records. The database connection uses a role (app_tenant_role) that does NOT have BYPASSRLS. Additionally, the RDS instance has a pg_hba.conf entry restricting the app_tenant_role to connections only from the Lambda security group CIDR, and the role has been configured with a row_security = on session default that cannot be overridden (ALTER ROLE app_tenant_role SET row_security = on). The RLS policy uses a RESTRICTIVE policy type (CREATE POLICY tenant_strict ON tenant_records AS RESTRICTIVE USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant'))). A secondary PERMISSIVE policy requires the tenant_id to match AND the record's visibility_scope includes the current user's role. The /api/debug endpoint returns the same diagnostics including cached tenant IDs. The /api/query endpoint remains accessible to authenticated users.

config.api_gateway: REST API with Cognito User Pool authorizer
config.db_role_privileges: app_tenant_role WITHOUT BYPASSRLS, row_security forced on
rls_policies: CREATE POLICY tenant_strict ON tenant_records AS RESTRICTIVE USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant'))
CREATE POLICY user_visibility ON tenant_records AS PERMISSIVE USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant') AND visibility_scope @> ARRAY[current_setting('app.current_user_id')])
config.role_config: ALTER ROLE app_tenant_role SET row_security = on; REVOKE BYPASSRLS FROM app_tenant_role
config.network: Lambda in VPC with NAT gateway, RDS in private subnet
